importantVerificationDistinctions: Installation-scenarios validates manifest, instructions and cached entry; install.native-prompt deliberately returns unsupported rather than completing OS installation.
Most harness tap calls are locator.click; the dedicated Search row scenario separately uses real Playwright touch events. An emulated viewport or user agent is not a physical phone.
Page-hidden, minimized, OS Home, locked screen, process termination and browser-close are distinct states and must have separately labelled results.
Safari Mac Add to Dock copies cookies but does not copy IndexedDB/Cache Storage or other local storage from the tab. Verify library/download persistence inside the installed web app itself.
Firefox manifest-based PWA installation differs from Firefox Windows taskbar web apps. Avoid the outdated blanket statement that Firefox cannot install web apps.
A WebKit Linux storage estimate gap does not establish a Safari iOS/macOS gap; Safari 17+ officially supports the Storage API.
Offline storage is subject to quota, eviction and user clearing; an installation does not establish permanent retention.
The historical physical protocol's Search byline-navigation expectation predates the published whole-row play-and-open-album contract. Use the new contract for current tests.

latestPublicInstallation.networkProof: Before disconnect: uncached random out-of-scope same-origin URL received HTTP404, not from cache or SW. Before and after offline reload: distinct random URLs rejected with native net::ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED and no HTTP response. App document reload returned HTTP200 from its real service worker.
